title: EATF verifier BoundaryReport v1
description: The per-check assessment boundary a verifier emits alongside every verification result (VerifyResult.boundary in the TypeScript verifier). One entry per check of the closed, versioned check registry (lib/src/check-registry.ts), in registry order, on success and failure alike. The report is computed from the verifier's own control flow, never from anything the package claims about itself; the registry is in turn pinned to the normative surface of docs/specs/aep-profile-v1.md by docs/specs/assessment-surface-v1.json and a CI two-set diff, so the denominator of 'what was assessed' cannot silently shrink.

registryVersion.description: Version of the check registry the report was computed against (CHECK_REGISTRY_VERSION).

registryDigest.description: SHA-256 hex content digest of the registry: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) bytes of {version, checks}. Lets a relying party pin the exact check universe.

checks.description: One entry per registry check, in registry order. A conforming report carries the FULL registry — including checks a short-circuited run never reached.

id.description: Stable check identifier from the registry.

clause.description: The aep-profile-v1.md clause this check executes, as labelled in the registry and the assessment-surface map.

verdict.description: pass/fail: the check executed and reached an outcome. not_assessed: the check never executed in this run. not_determinate: the check executed but could not reach an outcome (e.g. the TSA token carries no embedded certificate).

enforced.description: Whether this check's outcome counted toward the overall validity verdict in THIS run: true for gating checks that executed; false for advisory checks (a failure is reported without failing the package) and for checks that never executed.

reason.description: Machine reason code for a non-pass/fail verdict, where applicable. input_absent: the material the check needs is not in the package. capability_absent: the material is present but uses an algorithm or form this verifier cannot evaluate. option_disabled: the caller disabled the check (e.g. an empty TSA trust list). parse_failure: the material did not parse. short_circuited: an earlier outcome ended assessment before this check ran.

canonicalForm.description: Which supported canonical form canonical.bin matched (aep-profile-v1.md §6): 'profile' places metadata.json under the signature; 'response-only' leaves the whole of metadata.json outside it; null when verification failed before the canonical-form check.

unsignedFields.description: Top-level metadata.json fields that lie outside signature.sig, hash.sha256, and the RFC 3161 imprint under the matched canonical form, as 'metadata.<field>'. Empty under the profile form and when verification failed before the canonical-form check. overt_receipt.json is outside the signature in BOTH forms and is cross-checked via its content_hash only.

claimedSurface.description: Producer-claimed assessment surface, when metadata.json carries a claimed_assessment_surface string array (experimental; not yet part of the spec's §5 field table — and note that in the response-only canonical form the claim itself is unsigned). claimed echoes the sorted claim; unrecognized lists claimed ids absent from the registry; notAssessed lists claimed registry checks the run did not bring to a pass/fail outcome. A non-empty unrecognized or notAssessed is a claimed-vs-computed overclaim. null when the field is absent.
